Cluster PDF font sizes into heading levels and retain bounding boxes

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractionConfig, HierarchyConfig, PdfConfig, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), mime_type="application/pdf", uri="https://example.com/pdf/embedded_images_tables.pdf")
    config = ExtractionConfig(pdf_options=PdfConfig(extract_metadata=True, hierarchy=HierarchyConfig(enabled=True, include_bbox=True, k_clusters=6)))
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].pages)

asyncio.run(main())
```
